<p>Coach DeBoer might owe a slight apology to those of us who lost our minds in the first half of the Alabama vs. the kitty cats game. If we had just known “slow start” was his strategy for Saturday’s game we would have been giggling with delight over the first half. Each fumble, penalty, tackle for loss and interception could have brought total hilarity as opposed to the full <em>melt down/how many days until basketball season? </em>mode we experienced. We Crimson Tide fans had uk’s coach stein’s classy <em>call to action</em> to <em>his</em> fans…of sneaking in flasks and yelling obscenities at Alabama covered <em>without</em> the uk fans’ efforts.</p><p>However, sorry to reminisce, but remember back in 2022 when a reporter asked the GOAT about his quarterback strategy before playing the aggies, and Coach Saban fired back with this comment about sharing his game plan, “Um, I don't know. I was going to call Jimbo afterward and tell him. If he can hear it here in the press conference, then I don't have to call him." …Gosh, I miss that. So, there has been a positive precedent made here since Coach Saban was not one to share his game strategy either. We are just going to continue to stay in the dark and have faith!</p><p>Great job Alabama defense! You knew the call on the slow start for our offense and manned the ship while that covert scheme was going down. No one saw “turning off” the headsets in the 3rd quarter on the horizon either…allowing the offense to proceed full speed ahead on the kittens…up and down the field to the tune of 32-0 in the second half?! Woohoo! That’s “strategery” if we have ever seen it! Way to go Coach Deboer, but please don’t use that technique anymore. Though it appears sark took one from Coach DeBoer’s playbook, and, in the end, beat the #1 team in the land with the slow start style of play. But #6 oregon failed with the slow start plan going into half-time trailing unranked oklahoma state 24-17 only to lose to the cowboys 39-31.</p><p>I vote it’s time to retire the slow start blueprint at Alabama please. It’s overrated. Especially, when you recall the outcome of this same approach last year against fsu…as they are headed to Bryant Denny this weekend. But guess what? The seminoles already have a jump start on the Tide, because fsu had a bye this past weekend?! So, after playing smu September 7th, they have had nothing to do but prepare for the Alabama game?! Eek. Nervous any yet?</p><p>And while our game is for sure to be exciting, nothing is going to compare to the passion and emotions of the <em>Hate Bowl </em>coming to oxford Saturday night. If tennessee threw mustard at lane when he returned to neland stadium, shouldn’t his former doggie Juice be trained to bite him <em>accidentally</em> when he retrieves the football tee after kick-offs? It’s only fair. The way lane used Juice as part of his <em>good guy make over “I’m just a slow starter/I’ve developed and matured” </em>pr scheme and then left Juice in his crate in oxford when he hit I-55 to baton rouge?! The slow start game plan doesn’t work if that is who you truly are and never really grow out of it. Go ahead Juice – I say “extra treats for you and endless belly rubs” if you can sneak a little chomp into lane during your tee retrieval duties Saturday! Good boy!</p><p>And after all the off the field drama at the start of this football season, it looks like lsu’s sec legal concerns have been downgraded to “pending” with the postponement of their hearing last week. Thank goodness this issue will not be part of the game day tirade. No more current <em>suit </em>concerns in college football with the slight exception of minnesota’s coach pj fleck’s suit/nonsuit choices for game day…</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="408" width="612"></p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="190" width="191"></p><p>What is this? I don’t get it. Make up your mind – are you going to a cocktail party or to work out? It is not really advised to do both at the same time. Oh well, you do you, dude, as long as you don’t do it at Alabama!&nbsp;</p><p>Let’s suit up and beat the noles this Saturday, Alabama! RTR and enjoy Week 3!&nbsp;</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p>
